title: Medical Records Release Request
description: Request form for patients or authorized representatives to obtain copies of medical records. Requires photo ID verification and states the purpose of release.

title: IT System Access Request Form
description: Submitted by department HODs to request HIS access, email accounts, and system permissions for new or existing staff members. Must be submitted 48 hours before the staff start date.

title: Patient Financial Assistance and Waiver Application
description: Application form for patients requesting financial assistance or billing waiver. Requires income documentation and patient MRN. Waivers above 25% require escalated approval.

title: Patient Discharge Checklist
description: Checklist completed by the discharge coordinator verifying all discharge requirements: physician summary complete, bill settled, medications dispensed, follow-up booked, patient education given.

title: Insurance Pre-Authorization Request Form
description: Pre-authorization request submitted to TPA for planned procedures. Includes patient demographics, insurance details, diagnosis/procedure codes, and physician's clinical justification.

title: Surgical and Invasive Procedure Consent Form
description: Informed consent form for surgical procedures and invasive diagnostic interventions. Includes procedure description, risks, benefits, alternatives, and patient acknowledgment. Must be completed before procedure commencement.

title: Incident and Near-Miss Report Form
description: Completed by staff within 2 hours of any adverse event, near-miss, or safety incident. Captures event details, persons involved, immediate actions taken, and initial severity assessment.

title: Equipment Preventive Maintenance Work Order
description: Work order for scheduled preventive maintenance of biomedical equipment. Records: equipment ID, location, PM tasks performed, test results, calibration status, and next PM due date.

title: Patient Ward Transfer Request Form
description: Initiated by the attending physician to request intra-hospital ward transfer. Includes clinical justification, destination ward, patient condition, and isolation requirements.

title: Laboratory Specimen Rejection Notice
description: Issued by the laboratory when a specimen is rejected for analysis. Documents the rejection reason, re-collection instructions, and revised turnaround time.

title: Emergency Drug Stock-Out Notification Form
description: Raised by the Pharmacy In-Charge upon confirming a critical drug stock-out. Notifies treating physicians, ward nursing staff, and Supply Chain of the shortage and documents emergency procurement steps taken.

title: Emergency Department Triage Assessment Form
description: Completed by the triage nurse for every Emergency Department patient within 3 minutes of arrival. Captures chief complaint, ESI level, vital signs, allergy status, and triage nurse's name.
